build_HierarchicalTransformer: build a hierarchical transformer model with encoders, decoders, and transitions using HierarchicalArgs config
create_HierarchicalArgs: create a HierarchicalArgs dataclass to configure dimensions, layers, head dims, and pooling type for the model
estimate_flops_per_token: estimate FLOPs per token given model dimensions, layers, sequence lengths, and sliding window sizes
estimate_non_embed_param_count: estimate the number of non-embedding parameters in a transformer model from dimensions and layer config
build_fsdp_grouping_plan: build an FSDP grouping plan for encoders, decoders, and trunk layers from HierarchicalArgs
